docs.title: JSW Energy installed capacity reaches 15.1 GW, targets 3 GW renewable addition
docs.text: JSW Energy has added 1,694 MW of generation capacity since April 2026, taking its total installed capacity to 15,147 MW, the company said on October 5. JSW Energy added around 1.4 GW of renewable energy capacity during the period. Renewable energy now accounts for about 61% of JSW Energy’s operational portfolio. JSW Energy adds solar, wind, hybrid and hydro capacity The capacity added so far in FY27 includes 593 MW of solar, 108 MW of wind, 542 MW of hybrid and 150 MW of hydro capacity. The company also added 300 MW of thermal capacity through the acquisition of Maruti Clean Coal & Power. JSW Energy’s operational renewable energy capacity now stands at 9,189 MW. This includes 3,125 MW of wind, 2,426 MW of solar, 1,857 MW of hybrid and 1,781 MW of hydro capacity. The company’s thermal portfolio stands at 5,958 MW. Company on track to add 3 GW of renewable capacity in FY27 JSW Energy said it remains on track to achieve its target of adding 3 GW of renewable energy capacity in FY27. The company has already achieved around 46% of this target. Sharad Mahendra, Joint Managing Director and CEO of JSW Energy, said the company commissioned 1.4 GW of renewable energy capacity in the first half of FY27. “Having commissioned 1.4 GW of renewable energy capacity in the first half of FY27, we remain firmly on track to deliver the balance 1.6 GW during the year. The remaining capacity is fully derisked, with land, transmission connectivity, and equipment supply already in place,” Mahendra said. He added that favourable construction conditions in the second half of the financial year should help the company meet its annual capacity addition target. “Supported by a favourable construction season in the second half, we are well positioned to achieve our 3 GW annual capacity addition target, a significant milestone in our roadmap to 30 GW by FY30,” he said. JSW Energy has 32.4 GW locked-in generation capacity JSW Energy currently has a total locked-in generation capacity of 32.4 GW. This includes 15.1 GW of operational capacity and 14.5 GW under construction across thermal, hydro and renewable energy projects. The company also has a pipeline of 2.8 GW. Its locked-in energy storage capacity stands at 29.6 GWh. This includes 26.4 GWh of pumped hydro storage and 3.2 GWh of battery energy storage. JSW Energy said its growing storage capacity will help it provide firm and round-the-clock power as the power sector increasingly focuses on dispatchable electricity rather than only energy generation. JSW Energy targets 30 GW capacity by 2030 JSW Energy has set a target of reaching 30 GW of generation capacity and 40 GWh of energy storage by 2030. The company has also set a long-term target of achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

docs.title: Stock Market Today: Sensex ends 685 points higher, Nifty near 22,800; Trent ends 12% up
docs.text: Sensex today | Nifty 50 | Stock market Today at 3:30 PM: The benchmark indices ended sharply higher today, extending gains for the second consecutive session. The Nifty ended at 22,776.10 points, or 1% higher while the Sensex gained over 685 points or nearly 1% and ended at 73,067.81 points. Trent ended the day with over 12% gains, followed by BSE and Kotak Mahindra Bank with nearly 4% gains each. Coal India was the worst hit stock in the Nifty 50, ending over 3% lower, followed by Tech Mahindra with 2% loss. Sensex today | Nifty 50 | Stock market Today at 1:00 PM: The benchmark indices extended gains for the second consecutive day, with the Sensex climbing over 500 points and trading at around 72,886.64 points. The Nifty was hovering around 22,703 points. Trent remained the top gainer, rallying over 11%. Tech Mahindra and Coal India were the worst hit in the Nifty 50, declining over 2% each. Sensex today | Nifty 50 | Stock market Today at 10 am: The markets are holding steady. Sensex, Nifty are in the green. The new listings today, SRIT and Shah Investors have seen some traction in morning trade. SRIT listed at 13% premium to issue price. Shah Investors saw 4% uptick in morning trade. Sensex today | Nifty 50 | Stock market Today at open: The benchmark indices opened with slight gains today, October 6. The Nifty opened 0.3% higher at 22,603.25 points while the Sensex was up 80 points at 72,468.48 points. In the Nifty 50, Trent was the top gainer, surging 10% in early trade after the company’s business updates for the second quarter of financial year 2027. Kotak Mahindra Bank and BSE were also among the top performers, gaining 3.6% and 2.6%, respectively. Sterlite Technologies rose more than 3% after brokerage Nomura initiated coverage on the stock with a ‘Buy’ rating. Sensex today | Nifty 50 | Stock market Today at pre-open: GIFT Nifty is trading 84 points or 0.4% higher at 22,660 points in early trade on Tuesday, indicating a second straight day of strong opening for Indian equities. Indian benchmark indices had closed higher on Monday, with the Nifty ending 0.6% higher at 22,555.75 points. The Sensex had closed 0.7% higher at 72,382.47 points. Key global and domestic cues for October 6, 2026 Asian Markets Today Most Asian markets opened higher on Tuesday, October 6, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 rising 0.22% in early trade while the broader Topix gained 0.26%. South Korea’s Kospi opened 0.15% lower while the Kosdaq gained 1.91%. Australia’s S&P/ASX 200 was up 0.43%. ALSO READFrom 7.1% to 15.3%: HDFC Bank’s loan growth comeback is hard to ignore Crude Oil Today Crude oil prices traded slightly higher in early trading on Tuesday, with Brent crude oil hovering around $100.48 per barrel. Brent has however eased from Monday’s levels. The West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures was tad lower at $89.34 per barrel. US Stock Futures on Tuesday US stock futures were nearly flat in Tuesday’s trade. The US Yield at multi-year highs remained the big worry for the markets but traders seem to be looking past it. US Markets on Monday US stocks ended higher on Monday, with the Nasdaq Composite climbing to an all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained around 90 points or 0.2% and ended at 51,267.90 points. The S&P 500 ended 0.7% higher at 7,773.95 points. The Nasdaq Composite ended around 1% higher at 27,477.31, after hitting a record high. US 10-year, 30-year yield The 10-year US yield remained elevated at multi-year highs. The 10-year yield breached 5.3% again on Monday, at nearly levels last seen in 2002. The 30-year yield climbed past 5.7%, remaining a worry for markets. US Dollar Today The US Dollar Index (DXY) , which measures the value of the dollar against a basket of six foreign currencies, was trading at 102.15. The index evaluates the strength or weakness of the US dollar with major currencies. The basket contains currencies such as the British Pound, Euro, Swedish Krona, Japanese Yen, Swiss Franc, and others. On October 5, the Indian rupee ended at 96.29 against the US dollar. Gold Rate Today COMEX gold was trading marginally higher at around $4,145.57 per ounce in early trade on Tuesday. The rate for 24-carat gold today in India is Rs 1,49,180 per 10 grams. The 18-carat gold price today in India is Rs 1,11,885 per 10 grams. The 24-carat gold rate in Dubai today is Rs 1,36,304.97. Silver Rate Today COMEX silver was trading higher at $61.43 per ounce in early trade on Tuesday. Silver prices in India were at Rs 226.04 per gram on Tuesday. FII, DII data Foreign institutional investors continued to be sellers, giving up equities worth Rs 4,699.14 crores on Monday, according to NSDL data. Domestic institutional investors remained buyers and purchased shares worth Rs 5,181.62 crores. ALSO READ6 ‘Buy’ recommendations by Jefferies with 19% to 36% upside Top sectors in Monday’s trade In Monday’s trading session, the tobacco sector gained the most, ending 4.7% higher. This was followed by the aquaculture sector, which closed 3.8% higher, and the non-alcoholic beverage sector, which closed 3.4% higher. The retail sector was the worst hit, ending 3.5% lower, followed by the hospital sector. Group-wise gainers and losers in Monday’s trade In the last trading session, the Avantha Group gained 4%, followed by the DCM Group, which closed 3.7% higher. The Nagarjuna Group was the worst hit on Monday, ending 4.7% lower, followed by the Manipal Group at 4.2% lower.

docs.title: JP Morgan’s festive picks: Why Titan, Lenskart, LG Electronics, Pidilite top the list
docs.text: JP Morgan expects India's consumer discretionary sector to maintain steady growth in the second quarter of FY27, helped by premiumisation, store expansion, pricing actions and operating efficiencies. But the brokerage sees a more uneven earnings picture underneath the revenue numbers, with gold prices, raw-material costs, festive-season timing and higher operating expenses likely to determine how much of that growth reaches the bottom line. The brokerage's preferred names are Titan, Lenskart, LG Electronics India and Pidilite Industries. It is also positive on Vishal Mega Mart, Devyani International, Sapphire Foods India and Westlife Foodworld . Avenue Supermarts, Nykaa, Jubilant FoodWorks, Havells India and Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals are rated ‘Neutral’. Among the companies under coverage, JP Morgan expects Lenskart and Nykaa to deliver the fastest revenue growth in the quarter. In contrast, the paints, consumer durables and quick-service restaurant segments could see greater pressure on margins as input costs remain elevated. Festive demand is holding up, but the timing is different The second quarter is usually an important period for discretionary consumption, but this year the comparison is being complicated by changes in the timing of festivals and weddings. That is particularly relevant for jewellery, fashion and beauty categories, where purchases can move between months depending on the festive calendar. JP Morgan said, "Consumption trends remain broadly constructive across discretionary segments in the second quarter of financial year 2027, driven by premiumisation, formalisation, pricing actions, and value-led propositions. Festive timing shifts have affected seasonality across jewellery, fashion, and beauty and personal care." ALSO READFrom 7.1% to 15.3%: HDFC Bank’s loan growth comeback is hard to ignore The brokerage expects the underlying demand environment to remain supportive, with organised retailers continuing to gain from a wider store network and greater penetration. Premiumisation is another support, particularly for jewellery, beauty and personal care and selected discretionary categories. The important question for the quarter, however, is not simply whether companies grow revenue. It is how much of that growth survives higher input costs and operating expenses. Titan: Gold prices and studded jewellery on its radar Titan Company is expected to report 16% year-on-year revenue growth in the second quarter of FY27, with profit after tax projected to rise 20%, according to JP Morgan. The brokerage expects domestic jewellery revenue across Tanishq, Mia and Zoya to grow 25%. It expects the jewellery segment's earnings before interest and taxes margin to remain broadly stable at around 11%. The backdrop is complicated by the sharp rise in gold prices. JP Morgan expects plain-gold purchases to have faced some pressure in September as consumers delayed purchases amid price volatility. Studded jewellery, however, has remained more resilient. JP Morgan said, "While jewellery demand remained healthy in July-August, sharp gold price volatility in September appears to have weighed on buyer sentiment, leading consumers to defer purchases. Further festive shifts would have also affected growth in September." ALSO READNomura cuts Nifty target to 24,000 as US yields rise: Why IT, banks, auto are safe bets Titan has also been expanding its lower-ticket studded jewellery offering and strengthening its bridal portfolio through Tanishq Rivaah Wedding Signature. That gives the company more avenues to capture demand even as the timing of large jewellery purchases moves around. JP Morgan rates Titan Company ‘Overweight’. Lenskart : Emerging as one of the strongest growth stories Lenskart is expected to be one of the fastest-growing companies in JP Morgan's consumer coverage. The brokerage forecasts 29% year-on-year revenue growth in the second quarter of FY27 and 92% growth in profit after tax. India revenue is expected to rise 32%, while international revenue is forecast to increase 25%. The brokerage expects earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation margins before Indian Accounting Standards adjustments to reach 15.5% in India and 9.8% internationally. The growth case is being driven primarily by volumes, while operating leverage and cost efficiencies are expected to support profitability. JP Morgan said, "We expect Lenskart to sustain its solid growth trajectory and forecast 32% and 25% year-on-year growth for India and international businesses, driven primarily by volumes. We expect India and international pre-Indian Accounting Standards earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation margins of 15.5% and 9.8% respectively, on the back of operating leverage and cost efficiencies." docs.title: Why Trent share price surged 13% today: Zudio parent posts 23% Q2 revenue growth
docs.text: The share price of Trent, the parent company of retail businesses Zudio and Westside, surged nearly 13% intraday today, October 6. The stock is in focus after it released its business updates for the second quarter of financial year 2027. The stock breached its upper circuit of 10% and later soared even higher, to a more than one-month high of Rs 2,909. It gave up some of the gains and was trading 11% higher. The company’s Q2 revenue growth was also higher than brokerage house Motilal Oswal’s projections. The stock was the top gainer in the Nifty 50, Nifty 200, and Nifty 500. Trent Q2 performance The company’s standalone revenue for the quarter grew 23% year-on-year to Rs 5,788 crore. Trent’s revenue in the first half of FY27 was up 21% YoY at Rs 11,454 crore. Trent’s revenue from sale of merchandise, excluding other operating income, also grew by 23% for Q2 and 21% in the first half of the year. ALSO READAlmost debt-free, up 160%+: The fine print behind 2 smallcap high-flyers Trent net opened 10 Westside stores and 17 Zudio stores during the second quarter. The company opened its 1000th Zudio Store in Q2, taking its portfolio to 1,342 stores across Westside, Zudio, and other lifestyle brands. Motilal Oswal on Trent: Revenue above estimates The company’s standalone revenue growth of 23% was higher than Motilal Oswal’s estimate of 18%. The revenue growth was primarily driven by an increase in stores, the brokerage said. The company’s revenue per store declined around 1% YoY, against -5% in Q1, indicating “easing of cannibalisation impact,” Motilal said. The brokerage has a ‘Buy’ recommendation on the stock. Trent Q2FY27 earnings on October 29 The company’s board meeting for the financial results for the second quarter and the first half of FY27 will be held on October 29. In Q1, the company had reported a 26% YoY growth in standalone net profit at Rs 531.77 crore. Its revenue for the quarter was Rs 5,666.3 crore, up 19%. Its operating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortisation (EBITDA) for the quarter was Rs 847 crore. Its operating EBIT was Rs 732 crore and EBIT margin was at 12.9%.

docs.title: Despite an over 80% rise in less than 2 months, Motilal Oswal says buy this newly-listed stock - Reason, target price
docs.text: A newly listed stock has seen a solid gain of over 80% in less than two months, and despite this sharp rise, domestic brokerage firm Motilal Oswal Financial Services has a "buy" recommendation on it, with a target price implying 20% upside potential.We are discussing Molbio Diagnostics, a Goa-based healthcare company that develops fast, affordable, and accurate diagnostic tests. docs.title: Buy HDFC Bank Ltd for the Target Rs.1,225 by Emkay Global Financial Services Ltd
docs.text:
On 1-Oct-26, the RBI approved the appointment of Anup Bagchi, an ICICI Bank veteran and current MD&CEO of ICICI Life, as the MD & CEO of HDFC Bank for a three-year period starting 27-Oct-26. The approval is broadly in line with market expectations and media reports. We believe the appointment should help restore investor and customer confidence in the bank, given that Bagchi is a banking veteran with experience across diverse responsibilities within the ICICI Bank group. His non-obtrusive leadership style, focus on broader strategic priorities, and aversion to micromanagement should help him carry the core team along, although some churn at the senior management level is possible. Over the coming quarters,
1) ensuring stability in the upper management
3) improving the productivity of newer branches
4) upscaling technological and digital capabilities to match leading peers
5) strengthening processes to move beyond past issues, including instances of mis-selling. Overall, we believe this appointment should remove the prolonged overhang around management succession and help restore customer and investor confidence in the bank. Given the prolonged underperformance of HDFCB shares, the valuation has become attractive, and the stock should see a sustained re-rating as the new leadership delivers on key priorities and geopolitical uncertainty-led FPI outflows moderate or reverse. We reiterate BUY and TP of Rs1,225 on the stock.
 As widely expected, RBI appoints an “outsider” banking veteran 
Given the prolonged episodes of minor and major lapses and adverse developments at the HDFC Bank, it was widely anticipated and reported in the media that the RBI is likely to opt for an outsider to lead the bank after the current MD chose not to seek reappointment. In this context, Anup Bagchi’s appointment does not come as a surprise.
 Leadership style to carry the existing team together 
During his decades of leadership across various businesses within the ICICI Bank Group, Bagchi has come across as a non-obtrusive leader focused on broader strategic priorities, with a strong belief in delegation rather than micromanagement. This leadership style should help him garner strong support from the core team at HDFC Bank. However, some churn cannot be ruled out, as HDFC Bank will, for the first time in its 32-year history, be led by a chief executive from outside the organization.
 Progress on business performance should drive re-rating; reiterate BUY 
Notwithstanding recent lapses in certain processes and the bumpier-than-expected road following the HDFC merger, the HDFC Bank franchise remains formidable. As the bank begins to deliver on key business objectives, particularly in deposit and credit growth, investor confidence should return. The return of confidence, along with moderation or reversal of FPI outflows as geopolitical uncertainties subside, should drive a re-rating of HDFCB stock, which has de-rated significantly over the past several years. We reiterate BUY on the stock.

docs.title: Motilal Oswal initiates coverage on Molbio Diagnostics stock with Buy, sees 21% upside. Here's why
docs.text:
Motilal Oswal Financial Services has initiated coverage on Molbio Diagnostics with a 'Buy' rating and a target price of Rs 1,800, implying a potential upside of 21% from its current market price. The brokerage believes the diagnostics company is well placed to benefit from the expansion of decentralised molecular diagnostics, with its Truenat platform at the centre of the growth story. 
Molbio has built its business around Truenat, a portable molecular testing platform that enables point-of-care testing with limited infrastructure. The platform has more than 12,500 devices across over 90 countries and offers 43 assays covering 30 diseases.
 Why Truenat remains key to Molbio's growth 
 The biggest part of the thesis is not the sale of diagnostic devices, but the recurring revenue generated from test kits. Motilal Oswal said around 75% of Molbio's revenue comes from test kits, giving the company a consumables-led model.
 Live Events
 "The device creates the installed base, while proprietary test kits monetize it creating a razor-blade model."
 The brokerage said the same Truenat machine can support multiple diseases as the consumables change according to the test, while the company has another 34 assays in its pipeline. Lower utilisation of its devices and test kits also leaves room for growth without proportional additions to hardware.
 Motilal Oswal expects Molbio's revenue to grow at a 23% CAGR over FY26-29, with operating leverage supporting a 50% CAGR in PAT during the period. The brokerage expects EBITDA margins to expand as test-kit utilisation rises.
 Imaging and digital pathology add new growth engines 
The growth story is also moving beyond Truenat. Through Prognosys, Molbio has entered digital imaging, including ultra-portable X-ray systems. Motilal Oswal sees a strategic fit between Prognosys and Truenat, with X-rays helping screen patients for TB and Truenat providing molecular confirmation.
The brokerage expects Prognosys revenue to grow at around 36% CAGR over FY26-29.
Molbio's expansion into digital pathology through OptraSCAN provides another growth opportunity, although the brokerage said the business remains at an early stage and profitability is not expected in FY27.
 Valuation and risks 
Motilal Oswal said successful diversification beyond TB, stronger international adoption and improving cash conversion could support a re-rating. However, dependence on government orders and elevated working capital remain key risks.
"We believe Molbio is well positioned to capture the opportunity in decentralized molecular diagnostics via its integrated Truenat ecosystem, combining proprietary molecular diagnostic devices with a recurring test-kit franchise."
The brokerage has assigned a 45x 12-month forward earnings multiple to arrive at its Rs 1,800 target price. It also sees a bull-case target of Rs 2,575 and a bear-case target of Rs 1,100. 
With 12,500+ Truenat devices deployed across 90+ countries, 43 assays spanning 30 diseases and a USD 9.3 billion global POCT infectious-disease market growing at around 23% CAGR, Molbio has significant room for sustained growth.

docs.title: Best auto stocks to buy ahead of Q2 results: Eicher, Hyundai Motor, Tata Motors PV among Nuvama’s top picks | Full list
docs.text:
Nuvama’s coverage remains strongly positive across the auto sector, with Buy ratings dominating across two-wheelers, OEMs and auto-ancillary companies. Among two-wheelers, Eicher Motors, TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto and Hero MotoCorp are all rated Buy. In the OEM segment, Nuvama has a Buy rating on Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai Motor India, Mahindra & Mahindra, Tata Motors CV, Tata Motors PV, Ashok Leyland and Ajax Engineering, while Escorts Kubota is rated Hold. Among auto components, the brokerage remains positive on Samvardhana Motherson, Motherson Wiring, Uno Minda, Minda Corporation, Schaeffler and Timken, among others. Bharat Forge and Sona BLW are rated Hold, while CEAT also carries a Hold rating. For the September quarter, Nuvama expects aggregate revenue across its coverage, excluding Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, to grow 27% year-on-year, driven by robust industry volumes and improved pricing. However, EBITDA growth is expected to trail at 10%, as higher commodity prices, wage inflation and freight costs put pressure on profitability. Among OEMs, the brokerage expects strong EBITDA growth from Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Tata Motors Commercial Vehicles, TVS Motor and Bajaj Auto, while Exide Industries , Minda Corporation, ASK Automotive and Samvardhana Motherson International are expected to outperform among auto ancillaries. Domestic passenger vehicle volumes surged around 30% YoY during the quarter, while exports declined marginally. Nuvama expects revenue growth to be driven by higher volumes, price hikes, richer product mix and increasing electrification. Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles is expected to lead with 47% revenue growth in India, followed by M&M Auto at 34%, Maruti Suzuki at 27% and Hyundai Motor India at 19%. Domestic CV volumes rose around 28% YoY, helped by a favourable base and replacement demand. Nuvama expects the strong volume momentum, along with price hikes, to drive robust revenue growth. It estimates revenue growth of 49% for TMCV and 37% for Ashok Leyland. Domestic two-wheeler volumes increased around 15%, while exports jumped about 27%. Besides volume growth, better realisations and favourable currency movements are expected to support revenue. Nuvama expects TVS Motor to lead OEM revenue growth at 38%, followed by Bajaj Auto at 31%, Eicher Motors at 23% and Hero MotoCorp at 21%. Domestic tractor volumes are expected to decline around 5% YoY due to a high base, partly reflecting an early festive season and subsidy benefits. Nuvama expects Escorts Kubota's revenue to rise 14%, while Mahindra & Mahindra's farm-equipment business could see a 4% decline. Nuvama expects Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles' India PV revenue to surge 47%, while Jaguar Land Rover's revenue in GBP is estimated to increase 27% on a low base. India PV margins are expected to contract due to commodity inflation, while JLR is likely to see a notable margin improvement on a low base. JLR's year-ago quarter was impacted by a cyberattack that disrupted production and reduced volumes. The brokerage expects healthy double-digit revenue growth across its auto-ancillary coverage. Motherson Wiring India, ASK Automotive, Minda Corporation and Bharat Forge are expected to outperform, with estimated revenue growth of 40%, 38%, 34% and 31%, respectively. Despite the expected 27% revenue growth, Nuvama forecasts aggregate EBITDA growth of only 10% YoY, reflecting continued cost pressures from higher commodity prices, wage inflation and freight rates. The depreciating rupee is expected to provide some relief to companies with significant export exposure. Nuvama expects strong EBITDA growth from TMPV, TMCV, TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto, Exide Industries and Minda Corporation, while Hyundai Motor India, Apollo Tyres and CEAT are likely to see double-digit EBITDA declines. docs.title: Gold Falls 26% from January Peak – Should You Buy Ahead of Diwali? by Kaveri More, Commodity Technical Analyst at Choice Broking
docs.text:
Gold’s correction of more than 26% from its January peak (above $5,600/oz) has made valuations relatively more attractive, with prices now around $4,136/oz and MCX gold trading below the Rs1.50 lakh mark. However, the recent decline has been driven primarily by higher US Treasury yields and a firmer dollar, along with changing geopolitical expectations, while rupee movements are also influencing domestic prices. Hence, the correction appears more like a phase of consolidation and repricing rather than a reason to rush into lump-sum buying.
Ahead of Diwali, investors should avoid trying to identify the exact bottom and instead consider staggered buying over the next few weeks, preferably in 3–4 tranches. For festive or jewellery requirements, buyers can purchase according to their needs, while for investment purposes, Gold ETFs can offer greater flexibility and avoid jewellery-making charges. At the same time, gold may remain volatile and could see further downside before stabilising, with support seen around $3,950/oz. Investors should therefore maintain a sensible allocation to gold and avoid deploying funds that may be required for short-term expenses.

SOBHA’s strong sales momentum seen in FY26 continued into 1HFY27, aided by resilient demand in the Bengaluru real estate market. SOBHA clocked pre-sales of Rs22.1bn (16% yoy) in 2QFY27, vs our estimate of Rs20bn, resulting in Rs58.6bn of pre-sales in 1HFY27. We maintain BUY and TP of Rs1,900, based on 8x Sep-28E EV/embedded EBITDA, at 21% premium to NAV (the stock currently trades at a 23% discount to NAV).
Sobha clocked record quarterly pre-sales of Rs22.1bn (16% yoy) and half-yearly presales of Rs58.6bn (47% yoy). Quarterly pre-sales growth was driven by healthy realization growth (14% yoy) and marginal volume growth (2% yoy). In 2Q, Sobha had just two small project launches—one each in Kozhikode and Mysore—with aggregate GDV of Rs10-11bn. docs.title: Buy Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd for the Target Rs.500 by Emkay Global Financial Services Ltd
docs.text:
Mahindra Lifespace Developers (MAHLIFE) continues to see steady progress in its business development and launches. In 2Q, two of its projects—BeaconHill in Mahalaxmi and Citadel in Pune—have commenced pre-sales. However, due to seasonality, we expect pre-sales momentum to gain traction only from 3Q onward. The company is gearing up for launch of its Mahalunge, Pune project with GDV of Rs35bn in 3Q, having recently received RERA. Also, MAHLIFE has three more projects—at Borivali, Bengaluru, and Mulund with aggregate GDV of Rs41bn—in its pipeline for 2HFY27. Hence, the company is on track to meet its pre-sales guidance of Rs45-50bn in FY27E. We maintain BUY on MAHLIFE and TP of Rs500, based on 8x EV/embedded EBITDA at a 26% premium to the NAV (the stock is trading at 12% discount to NAV).
MAHLIFE has significantly accelerated business development over the last few years, with addition of projects worth Rs360bn during FY25-26, across MMR, Pune, and Bengaluru. The company has given guidance for Rs100-200bn GDV of business development in FY27E. MAHLIFE has added Rs71bn GDV YTD: i) outright in Kandivali with GDV of Rs56bn, and ii) three redevelopment projects—two in Borivali and one in Chembur with total estimated GDV of Rs15bn. MAHLIFE has Rs377bn GDV in the pipeline, as of beginning2Q. This strong pipeline provides visibility on the company’s ambitious FY30 pre-sales target of Rs95-100bn
We recently visited the ~60-acre Thane land parcel of MAHLIFE. The land parcel is in Gaimukh Gaon, Thane West and is in the vicinity of Godrej Emerald; it has an estimated development potential of ~6msf. The mixed-use project is predominantly residential and targeted for launch in 1QFY28, with IOD expected by 4QFY27. Current realizations in the micro-market are ~Rs17,000/sqft, while upcoming Metro Line 4 and the Thane–Borivali tunnel should improve connectivity.
We also visited Mahindra Rainforest, one of MAHLIFE’s largest projects, with ~Rs120bn GDV and five (total GDV: ~Rs30bn) of 12 towers in Phase 1 already launched. The next phase is expected to launch next year, while construction has commenced, with excavation underway. Customer traction remains healthy, with ~400–500 monthly walkins and a shorter conversion cycle; 2BHKs (worth ~Rs20mn each) are seeing the strongest response and demand for higher-ticket ~Rs40mn units has also picked up. We expect Rainforest to contribute >Rs10bn in pre-sales in FY27E.
